newsitem.title: JAPAN: Ogawa Sec seeks MOF permission to stop business.
newsitem.headline: Ogawa Sec seeks MOF permission to stop business.

text.p: Ogawa Securities Co Ltd, an ailing affiliate of "Big Four" brokerage Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd, said on Friday that it had applied to the Ministry of Finance (MOF) to wind up its business.
An Ogawa Securities official said that after the application for voluntary business termination is accepted, it will hold a shareholders' meeting on the dissolution of the securities house.
It would be the first brokerage to give back its licence and voluntarily terminate its business under a licensing system for securities houses introduced in 1968, industry analysts said.
In late May, Ogawa asked MOF to allow it to temporarily halt its business as Yamaichi had turned down Ogawa's request for help in improving its financial condition.
The Ogawa official added that the securities house was still in negotiations with Yamaichi over the future of Ogawa's personnel.
